name: NIST AI RMF 1.0
purpose: Organize ongoing contextual AI risk work across Govern, Map, Measure and Manage.
use_when: AI assists or executes a material business decision
do_not_use_when: Being used as a claim of legal compliance or certification
interpretation: Functions iterate; they are not four mandatory sequential checklist steps.
common_mistakes: Assuming a human sign-off alone removes risk
limitations: Revision in progress on official page at review; jurisdictional obligations need separate legal research
